entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I... I think I need to make a return? The website was a bit overwhelming and I'm not sure if I'm doing it right. I bought these cycling shoes a little while ago.
I can certainly help you with that. Just so I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
I'm not sure. I tried to attach the cleats, and they felt okay, but after one short ride they gave me really bad blisters. I think I just got the wrong size. It's all so confusing.
I'm very sorry to hear that they were uncomfortable. Getting the right fit is crucial. Let me pull up our return policy for you to see what we can do.
Oh, okay. I tried reading it but there were so many sections. Can't you just help me? I just want to know if I can get a refund.

Of course, I can definitely help with that. Let's see... according to our policy, items like your cycling shoes are eligible for a return within 90 days of delivery. It looks like you received them 17 days ago, so you are well within that window.
Oh, really? It's that simple? That's a huge relief. I was so worried.

It's that simple. I've gone ahead and approved the return for you. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email we have on file. Just box up the shoes with the cleats, attach the label, and you can drop it at the post office. Your refund will be processed once we receive the item.
Wow, thank you so much, Charlie. You made that very easy.
You're very welcome! Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
